Meta.title: Live Note Taker — Real-time class notes
Meta.description: Realtime class notes for students in Southeast Asia: VALSEA RTT with many recognition locales (ASEAN-first), Next.js + Supabase, light/dark, multi-language UI (VI, EN, ID, TH, MS).

Profile.libraryMetaDescription: Open and edit transcripts you saved from Live Note Taker.
Profile.libraryLead: Every note belongs to a folder (or “No folder”). Open a card to read and edit like a simple doc.
Profile.notesParentHint: Parent: Folders — organize captures first, then browse all notes here.
Profile.libraryEmptyBody: Capture a lecture on Live notes, then use Save note — your transcript will show up here.
Profile.editorHint: Plain text for now — fast and reliable. Use Save when you are done editing.
Profile.editorDeleteConfirm: Delete this note permanently? This cannot be undone.
Profile.editorSessionExpired: Your session ended — sign in again.
Profile.editorValseaHint: Run on the text below (uses your VALSEA account credits). Transcribe appends audio text to the note.
Profile.editorValseaNotConfigured: Add VALSEA_API_KEY on the server (e.g. Vercel env).
Profile.editorValseaTranscribeDone: Transcribed text was added to your note.
Profile.editorValseaTranscribeAria: Transcribe an audio file with VALSEA
Profile.editorValseaGuideIntro: Each request runs on the server with your VALSEA account and uses credits. Most tools replace the note text in the editor with the result. Sentiment only shows a short summary above the editor. Only one tool runs at a time (the active button shows a spinner).
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore3: Pick “Audio language” before Transcribe, then choose a file. Supported types include WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, and WebM.
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore4: Buttons that need note text stay disabled until the note is not empty. Transcribe is always available and appends text to the end of the note.
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore5: If you see a configuration error, VALSEA_API_KEY must be set on the server (for example in Vercel environment variables).
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_clarify: Rewrites the note for clarity and cleaner wording; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_translate: Translates the entire note to the language selected in “Translate to”; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_annotate: Adds annotations and optional corrections/tags; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_convert: Best after Annotate: turns annotated/tag-style text into clean readable prose; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_format: Restructures the transcript into the template chosen in “Format as” (minutes, summary, subtitles, etc.); updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_sentiment: Analyzes tone of the current text; shows sentiment, confidence, and a short rationale in a message — it does not change the note body.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_transcribe: Opens a file picker, sends the audio to VALSEA, and appends the returned transcript to the note (after any existing text).
Profile.foldersLead: Folders are the parent of your notes. Open a folder to see only the notes inside it, or jump to all notes.
Profile.foldersNoFoldersYet: Create a folder above, or save notes without a folder — they will appear under “No folder”.
Profile.folderEmptyBody: Save a note from Live capture and assign this folder, or move a note here from the editor.
Profile.folderDeleteConfirm: Delete this folder? Your notes stay saved and move to “No folder”.

Home.heroTitle1: Keep your eyes on the board,
Home.heroTitle3: Live Note Taker follows the lecture.
Home.heroSub: Turn on the mic once: VALSEA streams speech to text in real time. Watch partials to confirm you’re being heard; finals stack into notes you can review after class — stay with the lesson, not the typing.
Home.progressTitle: Hear the lesson — text fills in for you
Home.progressLesson: VALSEA realtime ASR · WebSocket & safe proxy
Home.progressMeta: Partials track your speech; only finals join your history — easier review after class, no jumpy lines.
Home.progressAria: Sample transcript and animated capture bar
Home.livePreviewFinal: Key idea: the chain rule — we’ll use it in problem set 3; this section often shows up on the midterm.
Home.livePreviewPartial: … still recognizing: "For problem three we’ll connect this to the midterm format, watch how we substitute…"
Home.catalogTitle: How Live Note Taker supports a lecture
Home.catalogSub: Each card is part of the pipeline — from mic to transcript and room to grow (storage, summaries…).
Home.cat1Desc: Partials appear instantly, finals stitch history — readable without a dense deck.
Home.cat2Desc: After MVP you just store notes & users — no surprise backend rewrite mid-term.
Home.cat3Desc: Follow VALSEA guidance; keys stay server-side for safer demos and deploys.
Home.cat4Desc: Run the proxy, open live, rehearse a 60s script — show you own the risks.
Home.whySub: Soft UI so long reading sessions stay comfortable — with a real VALSEA realtime pipeline underneath.
Home.why1Body: Friendly wording, minimal jargon; mentors get the story in one walkthrough.
Home.why2Body: One button to record — no timeline drag when judges are on a clock.
Home.why3Body: Late-night study? Dark mode. Sunny lecture hall? Pastels that stay easy on the eyes.
Home.why4Body: VI, EN, ID, TH, MS stay aligned — international teammates tap the right control instantly.
Home.story1Quote: The UI feels cute but the mic-to-text pipeline is real. Our pitch had the whole hall watching quietly.
Home.story2Quote: Prof asked about API safety — I toggled dark mode, pointed at middleware, and we moved on. Less nitpicks.
Home.story3Quote: I study late so dark mode saves me. Notes next morning are still gentle on my eyes.
Home.closingSub: Open live capture and speak a few lines like you’re in lecture — watch the transcript appear instantly.
Home.closingNote1: No credit card — just a mic and decent Wi-Fi.
Home.closingNote2: Dev: run npm run dev:rtt when testing RTT.

LivePage.title: Live notes
LivePage.subtitle: Choose the language you will speak, tap Start recording, and talk naturally — your words appear below as you go. Sign in if you want to save notes to your account.

Rtt.cardIntro: We use your microphone to stream speech to text in real time. Choosing the right language helps accuracy. You cannot change the language while recording is on.
Rtt.transcriptHint: The last line may shift while you are still talking; finished phrases move up into your running notes.
Rtt.asrLanguageHint: Match this to how you will speak in class or meetings. The list favors Southeast Asia and nearby regions. It is separate from the app language in the header.
Rtt.emptyHint: Nothing here yet. Tap Start recording and speak — your transcript will show up in this box.
Rtt.statusRecording: Listening — keep talking, your notes update live.
